contract.title: 4-bit LFSR (XNOR feedback)
contract.description: Build a 4-bit linear feedback shift register. CLK is the clock lever; the lamps Q0..Q3 show the register (all off at the start). On every rising edge of CLK (switched ON) the register shifts by one place and the new Q0 is the XNOR of the old Q2 and Q3: Q0 := NOT(Q2 XOR Q3), Q1 := old Q0, Q2 := old Q1, Q3 := old Q2. Switching CLK off changes nothing. From all-off the register runs through 15 different states and then repeats. CLK stays on and off for at least 20 ticks each. Library hint (component tier only): D flip-flop, XOR gate and NOT gate cells are available.
